examples.title: Identifying Humor
examples.problem: Find an instance of humor in the story.
examples.solution: Gopal's wife asking him 'Why is your face half-shaven?'
examples.explanation: The contrast between the serious courtier and his ridiculous look creates humor.

examples.title: Understanding Plot Twist
examples.problem: What was the 'impossible' thing Gopal achieved?
examples.solution: He made people forget their obsession with Hilsa fish by becoming the obsession himself.
examples.explanation: By changing the focus of public attention, he controlled the conversation.

examples.title: Vocabulary: Courtier
examples.solution: A person who attends a royal court as a companion or adviser to the king.
examples.explanation: Courtiers were often expected to be witty and intelligent.
